summary: Sibanye Stillwater Limited filed a routine Form 6-K on 28 September 2026, signed by CFO Charl Keyter, with an exhibit index listing Exhibit 99.1, a market release, and an embedded JPEG image. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16/15d-16 and the excerpt contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date. It is a standard current report rather than a special situation. No deal terms are stated and no risk-arb angle is identifiable without the exhibit text.
